## Default Permission

Read local sessions, configure monitoring and control Agent Studio windows.

#### This default permission set includes the following:

- `allow-monitor-state`
- `allow-rail-settings-get`
- `allow-rail-settings-set`
- `allow-collector-request`
- `allow-set-hit-regions`
- `allow-close-settings`
- `allow-open-view`
- `allow-open-session-url`
- `allow-open-integration-folder`
